rubric_verbatim:
Table 4: Scoring criteria for assessing the extent to which studies address the identified research gaps.
Score
Scoring rule
Evidence required
0 — Not relevant
The study does not discuss the specific gap or provide a contribution addressing it.
A full-text relevance check. Similar keywords alone are not sufficient.
1 — Recognition only
The study identifies the gap but does not provide a contribution addressing it.
A direct quotation identifying the gap, with its page and section.
2 — Contribution proposed
The study presents a method, framework, algorithm or data contribution addressing the gap but does not evaluate it.
A description of the contribution and how it relates to the gap.
3 — Contribution evaluated
The contribution is implemented and tested, but its performance is not checked against observations or data from an actual deconstruction project.
The evaluation method, test setting and results. Tests may use simulations or laboratory demonstrations.
4 — Contribution evaluated using actual project observations
The contribution is implemented and tested against recorded observations or data from an actual deconstruction project.
The project-data source, measured information, evaluation method and results.
